name: Nayara Energy
description: Indian downstream company (Rosneft-backed) operating the Vadinar refinery on the Gulf of Kutch, Gujarat — India's second-largest single-site refinery, capable of handling a diverse crude slate — plus the country's fastest-growing private fuel-retail network. Pursuing a phase-wise asset-development strategy to enter petrochemicals as part of a crude-to-chemicals journey.
products: Vadinar refinery (Gulf of Kutch, Gujarat) — India's second-largest single-site refinery
